title: agent-atlas Job manifest
description: A long-running / asynchronous unit of work (e.g. a Celery task) dispatched to a queue rather than blocking the reasoning loop.

queue.description: The task queue this job is dispatched to.

trigger.description: What dispatches this job (the id of the tool or agent that enqueues it).

governance.description: Regime-neutral trust/privacy controls (NIST AI RMF: privacy, security, accountability). Optional — declare what the requirements state; leave the rest for a human.

data_classification.description: Sensitivity of the data this object touches.

data_tags.description: Regulatory data classes (MULTIPLE may apply, e.g. PHI and PII).

residency.description: Where data may be processed/stored. 'on-prem' = never leaves the boundary.

redaction.description: Fields to filter/redact/drop before telemetry is indexed.
